spell.vravenaddon.ignition.guide: Channel fire magic through your body, granting fire immunity, increasing movement speed, and increasing fire spell power.
spell.vravenaddon.fire_step.guide: A quick dash forward through a burst of flames.
spell.vravenaddon.graced_rain.guide: Summons a magical cloud at the target location. The cloud releases a graceful rain that heals living beings and significantly accelerates plant growth in the area below. It does not affect undead (deals damage to them).
spell.vravenaddon.mana_charge.guide: Focus your energy to recover mana.
spell.vravenaddon.barrier.guide: Creates an energy shield in front of the caster that blocks projectiles. Each hit on the shield consumes your mana. When targeting an ally, applies the shield to them. Rumors say the shield resonates with the caster's element...
spell.vravenaddon.gravity_force.guide: Condenses gravity around the caster, increasing the strength and speed of their attacks.
dot.vravenaddon.gravity_force_descriptio: Condenses gravity around the caster, increasing the strength and speed of their attacks.
spell.vravenaddon.frost_coating.guide: Covers the body in a layer of magical ice, strengthening armor and protecting against enemy spells.
dot.vravenaddon.frost_coating_descriptio: Covers the body in a layer of magical ice, strengthening armor and protecting against enemy spells.
spell.vravenaddon.thunder_step.guide: Teleports the caster to the target location, releasing a chain lightning at nearby enemies before moving. Re-casting allows for a series of jumps.
spell.vravenaddon.blizzard_aspect.guide: Surrounds the caster with an icy aura. Every few seconds, a snow squall strikes nearby enemies, dealing damage and creating a slowing cloud of frost mist.
death.attack.vravenaddon.blizzard_aspect: %1$s was buried under player %2$s's avalanche caused by %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.sacred_slash.guide: Launches a holy crescent that pierces through enemies, marking them with a guiding light effect.
death.attack.vravenaddon.holy_wave.item: %1$s was sliced by player %2$s's holy wave using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.fire_cleanse.guide: Invokes the power of fire to burn away all negative effects, but in return consumes 10% of your health and sets you on fire.
death.attack.fire_cleanse.player: %1$s was burned for their sins by player %2$s
spell.vravenaddon.holy_step.guide: Instantly teleports in the direction you are looking. Upon arrival, summons a beam of light that strikes the ground and deals damage.
spell.vravenaddon.blood_fortification.gu: Fortifies the body and accelerates mana flow by condensing the blood.
ui.vravenaddon.blood_fortification_info: Fortifies the body and accelerates mana flow by condensing the blood.
spell.vravenaddon.flame_excalibur.guide: An ultimate technique created by Vraven. You unleash the full power of fire through the blade of your sword, delivering a devastating blow to enemies. The energy is so immense that the steel cannot withstand the strain and crumbles into dust after use.
death.attack.vravenaddon.flame_excalibur: %1$s was wiped from existence by %2$s's power
%1$s could not withstand the force of %3$s, unleashed by %2$s
spell.vravenaddon.flower_field.guide: Creates a flower field around the caster. 'A garden that is always with her. Created for Oleksa, to fill this harsh world with flowers and meaning.'
spell.vravenaddon.fiery_dagger.guide: Summons a fan of magical fiery daggers that hover above the caster and launch sequentially at the target location. The daggers set targets on fire and completely ignore their invulnerability frames, dealing devastating consecutive damage.
death.attack.vravenaddon.fiery_dagger: %1$s was turned into a pincushion by %2$s's fiery daggers
death.attack.vravenaddon.fiery_dagger.it: %1$s could not survive %2$s's barrage of fiery daggers unleashed from %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.bloodwing_wrath.guide: Awakens the ancient spirits of the bloodwings and channels the power of the Blood Harbinger, Oleksa. Unleashes a massive crimson shockwave that damages surrounding enemies, granting the caster wings of condensed blood for temporary flight and life-steal.
death.attack.vravenaddon.bloodwing_wrath: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's bloodwing wrath
%1$s could not escape the wrath of the bloodwings unleashed by %2$s using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.raid_commander.guide: Blows a war horn, taking command of the battlefield. Drastically increases the damage of your summons, grants additional movement speed while casting, and amplifies the power of all your Evocation spells.
dot.vravenaddon.raid_commander_descripti: Drastically increases the damage of your summons, grants additional movement speed while casting, and amplifies the power of all your Evocation spells.
spell.vravenaddon.summon_iron_golem.guid: Channels ancient earth magic into the ground to forge two heavy Iron Golems to protect you. Recasting the spell while they are alive dismisses them.
dot.vravenaddon.summon_iron_golem_descri: Summons two heavy Iron Golems to protect you.
spell.vravenaddon.abyss_breath.guide: Unleashes a continuous torrent of volatile abyss fire in a cone before you. The dark flames incinerate targets, dealing continuous damage and inflicting them with Abyssal Burn.
death.attack.vravenaddon.abyss_breath.it: %1$s was consumed by %2$s's abyssal torrent using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.shattered_crescent.gui: Concentrates the fury of the Abyss, unleashing two devastating slashes in a row — vertical and horizontal. If both strikes hit the target in quick succession, the point of their intersection collapses, tearing open an Abyssal Rift. This cross on the fabric of reality is a scar of absolute solitude, forever sealed within the very origin of this power.
death.attack.vravenaddon.shattered_cresc: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's Shattered Crescent
%1$s fell victim to %2$s's demonic anguish, unleashed through %3$s
Concentrates the fury of the primordial flame, materializing a legendary weapon. Infuses the caster with the Crucible Soul effect, granting colossal combat power for the duration of the blade.
item.vravenaddon.crucible_blade.ability_: Melee attacks have a 50% chance to trigger a fiery burst, dealing
item.vravenaddon.crucible_blade.synergy: Ignited effect guarantees the fiery burst.
item.vravenaddon.crucible_blade.fire_ste: • When held in hand, allows casting 'Fire Step' 2 times in a row.
item.vravenaddon.crucible_blade.ability_: fire spell damage. The burst ignites enemies and inflicts an effect that temporarily weakens their defense.
item.vravenaddon.crucible_blade.lore: The embodiment of the martial spirit of a true Fire Harbinger. Its blade is woven from the pure flame of Igrid. Ordinary steel would crumble under such heat, but this magical projection is indestructible. Every swing generates slashing waves of fire, leaving enemies with no chance of escape.
spell.vravenaddon.thunder_clap.guide: The caster takes a low iaido stance, accumulating lightning energy before executing a lightning-fast forward dash. Slicing through space, it deals devastating damage to all enemies in its path and stuns them with an electrical shock.
spell.vravenaddon.life_bloom.guide: Materializes the Scarlet Lily — a powerful blade of blood. The caster gains the Bonds of Blood effect, granting absolute immunity to debuffs and empowering them, while surrounding allies are filled with the Will of the Blood Harbinger.
item.vravenaddon.scarlet_lily.ability_de: Every strike unleashes a slitting blood blade, dealing %s blood spell damage.
item.vravenaddon.scarlet_lily.debuff_imm: • The wielder gains absolute immunity to any debuffs and fortifies surrounding allies.
item.vravenaddon.scarlet_lily.lore: "She united broken fates and granted them a true home. In her grace lies the majestic power of Erythron, and in her gaze is a captivating beauty, deep quiet wisdom, and that pure bright magic that makes the earth bloom. May this blade, blossoming with scarlet petals, forever protect the one who became the heart of our world."
spell.vravenaddon.fiery_sword_rain.guide: Marks an area on the ground and summons a continuous rain of fiery swords cascading down at an angle. The blades ignite targets and deal frequent damage to all caught within the impact zone.
death.attack.vravenaddon.fiery_sword_rai: %1$s was buried under %2$s's rain of fiery swords
%1$s did not survive %2$s's fiery sword fall summoned with %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.ice_arrow.guide: Fires a razor-sharp arrow of pure ice that pierces the target, dealing ice spell damage and inflicting frostbite.
death.attack.vravenaddon.ice_arrow.item: %1$s was pierced by %2$s's ice arrow using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.ice_arrow_rain.guide: Marks an area on the ground and summons a frost flurry of ice arrows bursting directly from beneath the earth at an angle. The arrows pierce targets, dealing frequent ice spell damage, heavily freezing them, and inflicting frostbite.
death.attack.vravenaddon.ice_arrow_rain: %1$s was riddled by %2$s's rising ice arrows
%1$s did not survive %2$s's ice storm summoned using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.galvanism.guide: Infuses the body with a high-frequency electrical charge. Upon activation, knocks back surrounding enemies with an electric pulse, while granting the caster increased sprinting speed, attack speed, and mana recovery.
dot.vravenaddon.galvanism_description: Significantly increases sprinting speed, attack speed, and mana regeneration.
spell.vravenaddon.raven_sight.guide: An ultimate art perfected by Vraven during his long stay in the Otherworld. By thoroughly studying the concept of the soul itself, he linked his vision to the mana flow of living beings. Allows you to look beyond the mortal veil, reading the internal energy, hidden elemental affinities, and exact mana pools of any entities.
spell.vravenaddon.darkness_infusion.guid: Envelops the caster in concentrated shadow energy, creating a vortex that pulls in all nearby enemies. Grants wither immunity and massively increases physical power, movement speed, and darkness spell power.
dot.vravenaddon.darkness_infusion_descri: Pulls in nearby enemies, grants wither immunity, and significantly increases combat stats and darkness spell power.
spell.vravenaddon.purgatory.guide: The caster concentrates dark energy and performs a swift dash through space, slicing through everyone in their path. At the moment of launch, the spell slows surrounding enemies, and the strike envelops victims in pitch-black darkness.
death.attack.vravenaddon.purgatory.item: %1$s did not survive %2$s's dark purgatory slash using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.dark_step.guide: Instantly teleports the caster through shadows in the direction they are looking, dissolving into a cluster of dark matter and leaving a trail of Darkness.
spell.vravenaddon.dark_slash.guide: The caster performs a series of rapid swings, sending arcs of shadow energy forward. Each slash deals damage calculated from spell power and main-hand weapon damage.
death.attack.vravenaddon.dark_slash: %1$s was torn apart by darkness released by %2$s
death.attack.vravenaddon.dark_slash.play: %1$s was torn apart by darkness released by %2$s
spell.vravenaddon.dimensional_slash.guid: Supreme swordsmanship art created by Vraven based on the 'Excalibur' technique. By redirecting the destructive strike's power from fire into concentrated anti-magic darkness, the blade cuts through the fabric of reality itself. The released wave passes through all blocks, dealing damage, slowing, and blinding enemies. The shadow cut dispels any magical buffs, interrupts casts, and destroys anomalous phenomena — up to black holes. Requires a sword in the main hand.
death.attack.vravenaddon.dimensional_sla: %1$s relied on magical protection, but was sliced along reality by %2$s
%1$s did not survive %2$s's dimensional slash with %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.dark_rift.guide: Slashes space in front with a blade swing, creating a Dark Rift. Recasting the spell opens a second rift, linking them into a stable two-way spatial portal.
spell.vravenaddon.dark_breath.guide: Unleashes a continuous cone stream of concentrated shadow energy. Black fire incinerates targets and burns their mana, dealing damage, setting them ablaze, and plunging them into pitch-black darkness.
death.attack.vravenaddon.dark_breath.ite: %1$s was consumed by %2$s's dark flame using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger.guide: An evolution of the 'Fiery Dagger' technique, reimagined by Vraven. A fan of materialized shadow daggers created from a dark projection soars above the caster. The projectiles sequentially launch at the target, ignoring invulnerability frames. The daggers embed into enemies and ignite them with Black Fire, which continuously burns away their mana and life force.
dot.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger_descriptio: Hit targets with shadow daggers, burning mana with Black Fire.
death.attack.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger: %1$s was turned into a pincushion by %2$s's shadow daggers
death.attack.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger.p: %1$s was completely exhausted and torn apart by player %2$s's shadow daggers
death.attack.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger.i: %1$s could not survive %2$s's barrage of shadow daggers unleashed from %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger_forest.g: Creates a shadow glade on the ground that slows all enemies standing within it. Shadow daggers continuously burst from the ground, soaring upward and piercing targets. The blades ignite victims with Black Fire and deal frequent damage.
dot.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger_forest_des: Creates a glade of Darkness, piercing and slowing enemies with daggers bursting from the ground.
death.attack.vravenaddon.shadow_dagger_f: %1$s was dragged into player %2$s's shadow dagger forest
%1$s was dragged into player %2$s's shadow forest
%1$s did not survive %2$s's shadow dagger rain summoned with %3$s
%1$s was pierced by %2$s's rising shadow dagger
spell.vravenaddon.black_moon.guide: Summons an impenetrable dark dome with a floating Black Moon at its center. Distorts space around the caster, absorbing projectiles, slowing and weakening enemies, and protecting allies within.
Concentrates Darkness energy, materializing the legendary Mugetsu blade from the subspace void. Infuses the caster with the 'Moonless Night' effect, imbuing attacks with anti-magic power to slice through enemies and anomalies.
item.vravenaddon.mugetsu_katana.ability_: Strikes have a 50% chance to cause a gravitational impulse of darkness, igniting the target with
dark damage while pulling in all nearby enemies.
item.vravenaddon.mugetsu_katana.parry_bo: • Blade swings parry incoming projectiles in front, including magic ones.
item.vravenaddon.mugetsu_katana.lore: Darkness settles only where absolute precision reigns. Vraven shaped a subspace tear into the form of an ancient katana from his homeland — a weapon whose hilt his hand remembers from youthful duels. In Mugetsu's blade there is no reflection, and its swing summons absolute Moonlessness, severing space and burning away foreign mana.
spell.vravenaddon.judgment_cut.guide: Supreme technique of spatial swordsmanship. Traps the target in a sphere of compressed Darkness, holding them in place and dealing a flurry of rapid spatial slashes. The attack ignores invulnerability frames, shatters target defense, and burns away their mana.
death.attack.vravenaddon.judgment_cut: %1$s felt %2$s's absolute motivation and was disintegrated by a spatial flurry
death.attack.vravenaddon.judgment_cut.it: %1$s was sliced to pieces by %2$s using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.eclipse_slash.guide: The caster forms a crescent wave of Darkness. Normal cast unleashes a wide horizontal slash that deals area damage, ignites targets with Black Fire, and knocks them back with a dark impulse. Casting with Shift held releases a narrow vertical slash that passes through any blocks and entities: it pierces targets in its path and possesses anti-magic effects.
death.attack.vravenaddon.eclipse_slash.i: %1$s did not survive %2$s's eclipse slash released with %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.blood_shackle.guide: Fires a projectile of concentrated blood. Upon hitting an enemy or block, blood chains burst out, tethering nearby targets to surrounding surfaces (walls, floor, or ceiling) and restricting their movement.
death.attack.vravenaddon.blood_shackle: %1$s was bound and torn apart by %2$s's blood chains
death.attack.vravenaddon.blood_shackle.i: %1$s was chained to a wall and destroyed by %2$s using %3$s
spell.vravenaddon.blood_storm.guide: Summons blood clouds above the selected area, continuously raining down a hail of blood needles that deal damage and heal the caster.
spell.vravenaddon.summon_bloodwings.guid: Summons a flock of vampiric bats bound to the caster that periodically attack surrounding enemies, dealing blood spell damage and healing the master. Additionally grants the caster the Blood Echolocation effect.
death.attack.vravenaddon.summon_bloodwin: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's swarm of blood bats
%1$s fell victim to player %2$s's swarm of blood bats
%1$s did not survive the attack of %2$s's blood bats summoned with %3$s
item.vravenaddon.dark_sheath.desc: On hit, ignites entities with Black Fire for 4 seconds and grants a 25% damage bonus against burning targets
